```{r}

library(here)

```


```{r}
data <- load_data("INMLCF_debugged_2015_2024.csv", type = "interim")
```

```{r}
replace_info <- function(df) {
  df[] <- lapply(df, function(col) {
    if (is.character(col) | is.factor(col)) {  # Apply only to text columns
      col <- ifelse(col == "Sin Información", "Sin información", col)
    }
    return(col)
  })
  return(df)
}
```

```{r}
data <- replace_info(data)
```

```{r}
data |> explore()
```
```{r}
data %>% report(output_dir = tempdir())
```
```{r}
data %>% report(target = tipo_lesion, output_dir = "data")
```
